disposition_mapping.rationale: Extraction is automated with the GL accountant handling only exceptions; the function, including mandatory consumption of the risk-rating schedule and closing rates for FX retranslation (KB-07), persists but its mechanics are reorganised.
Matching moves to an automated-first model with exception routing; the matching function itself survives as required (ACR-R-02), only its execution boundary changes.
Investigation and classification of reconciling items is unchanged in substance, satisfying ACR-R-03 and the evidential-trail principle (KB-02).
Adjusting journal entry preparation survives, still consuming the prior-period error record (ACR-R-04, ACR-R-06) and preserving estimation-entry judgment (KB-04, KB-10).

Preparer sign-off is unconstrained by design; it is folded into the submission action of journal-entry preparation as a system-captured attestation rather than kept as a standalone manual step, with no requirement broken.

Independent reviewer approval survives as required (ACR-R-09) and remains performed by the finance controller, distinct from the GL accountant who prepares entries in TS-04, satisfying the actor-separation requirement (ACR-R-05).

Escalation of aged items is unconstrained by design; it is subsumed into continuous automated ageing monitoring embedded in the evidence-retention and reporting step rather than retained as a discrete manual escalation step.

Evidence retention and status reporting survives as required (ACR-R-08) but is reorganised to also carry the escalation-monitoring function, consolidating two controller-adjacent activities into one continuously operating step.

steps.description: The reconciliation platform extracts GL and comparison balances (bank, subledger, third party) for every in-scope account on its risk-rated due date, automatically retranslating foreign-currency balances at the closing rate per IAS 21 (KB-07). The GL accountant reviews extraction exceptions (missing feeds, stale rates) rather than performing extraction manually.
inputs: Reconciliation schedule by account risk rating
steps.name: Automated balance extraction and FX retranslation

steps.description: Transactions are matched between GL and comparison source automatically using configurable matching rules; the GL accountant is routed only unmatched or low-confidence items for manual matching. The automated-match rate is monitored to ensure the matching function, not merely its tooling, is auditable.
steps.name: System-driven transaction matching with exception handling

steps.description: Unmatched items are investigated, explained, supported with evidence and classified, preserving the evidential trail linking reconciling items to reported balances required for faithful representation (KB-02).
steps.name: Investigate and classify reconciling items

steps.description: Adjusting journal entries are prepared for items requiring correction, with prior-period errors corrected retrospectively per IAS 8 (KB-05), and estimation-based adjustments (e.g. provisions, impairments, NRV write-downs) retain a documented human basis (KB-04, KB-10). Submission to review automatically captures the preparer's attestation that the reconciliation is complete and supported, eliminating the separate manual sign-off step without removing the attestation itself.
steps.name: Prepare and submit adjusting journal entries

steps.description: An independent reviewer, distinct from the preparer of the adjusting entries, reviews and approves the reconciliation and its adjusting entries, maintaining segregation of duties between preparation and review.
steps.name: Reviewer approval

steps.description: The platform continuously ages open reconciling items against risk-based thresholds and auto-triggers escalation to the finance controller when thresholds are breached, replacing a discrete manual escalation step with embedded monitoring. Reconciliation evidence is retained and status, including open escalations, is reported, preserving the evidential trail (KB-02) and the error-correction visibility (KB-05) required in the target state.
steps.name: Continuous monitoring, aged-item escalation, evidence retention and status reporting
